protocol.scenario: cold Home route only; no setup or game interaction
protocol.serviceWorkers: blocked; an init-script inert container and inert registration are supplied for the benchmark context
protocol.readiness: load, #home-title, home hero image decoded, document.fonts.ready, then 250 ms
protocol.orderGeneration: seeded xorshift32; each viewport has AB/BA counts balanced within one, then all pair tasks are deterministically shuffled
protocol.resourceAccounting: same-origin Resource Timing entries except navigation document; per-resource values retained
protocol.lcp: latest LCP candidate observed after the readiness wait; not asserted as a formal page-final value
protocol.graphics: prebuilt production output served without asset interception, source or resolution changes
protocol.interpretation: Measurement evidence only; this runner makes no performance-win decision.
